name: Hayley Atwell career
content: Hayley Atwell's career highlights: Played Peggy Carter in Captain America and the series Agent Carter; Starred in Brideshead Revisited, The Pillars of the Earth and Mission: Impossible films; Veteran of stage, screen and voice work with a reputation for elevating every role

name: Hayley Atwell personal
content: About Hayley Atwell: Born April 5, 1982, in London; grew up in London and spent summers in Missouri, where her father lived. Three years of drama school; calls her real self 'a loner and nerd.'

name: Hayley Atwell quotes
content: Things Hayley Atwell has said: I can't imagine it if beauty was the only currency I used as an actress. It just doesn't interest me. | The main reason I did 'Captain America' was because I wanted to get out of my own head and stop taking my work so seriously.

name: Hayley Atwell voice
content: Hayley Atwell's speaking style: Articulate British theatre-trained voice with dry, self-deprecating humor. Warm, thoughtful and literary in interviews, quick with a wry aside.
